svg.aria-label: Trunk: The web build uses Trunk (https://trunkrs.dev/). Lighter quality tier: The browser picks a lighter quality tier: less bloom, flat CRT. Keyboard required: There are no touch controls yet. Fixes and pitfalls: WASM_BUILD.md has the browser-specific fixes and pitfalls
